mapper.select:
select id, source, source_id as sourceId, title, category, tags, cover, published_at as publishedAt, url, has_video as hasVideo, date_format(published_ts, '%Y-%m-%d') as publishedTs,
case when content_text is not null and content_text <> '' then 1 else 0 end as hasDetail from tool_web_post
order by case when home_rank is null then 999999 else home_rank end asc, coalesce(published_full, cast(published_ts as datetime)) desc
order by coalesce(published_full, cast(published_ts as datetime)) desc, cast(source_id as unsigned) desc, id asc
limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from tool_web_post

select id, source, source_id as sourceId, title, category, tags, cover, published_at as publishedAt, url, has_video as hasVideo, content, content_text as contentText, image_count as imageCount, video_count as videoCount, video_url as videoUrl, video_urls as videoUrls, video_ratios as videoRatios, video_file as videoFile, download_state as downloadState, download_percent as downloadPercent, download_error as downloadError, archive_state as archiveState, archive_percent as archivePercent, archived_at as archivedAt from tool_web_post where id = #{id} limit 1

select id from tool_web_post t where t.source = #{source} and t.published_ts is not null and t.published_ts <= cast(#{dateTo} as date) and t.category = #{category} and find_in_set(#{tag}, t.tags) > 0
and not (
coalesce(find_in_set(#{bt}, t.tags), 0) > 0
)
order by t.published_ts desc, cast(t.source_id as unsigned) desc limit 1

select case when #{index} > 0 and ifnull(json_length(video_urls), 0) > #{index} then json_unquote(json_extract(video_urls, concat('$[', #{index}, ']'))) when #{index} > 0 then null
when ifnull(json_length(video_urls), 0) > 0 and json_unquote(json_extract(video_urls, '$[0]')) like 'http%' then json_unquote(json_extract(video_urls, '$[0]'))
when video_url is null or video_url = '' or video_url not like 'http%' then json_unquote(json_extract(video_urls, '$[0]')) else video_url end from tool_web_post where id = #{id} limit 1
select ifnull(json_length(video_urls), 0) from tool_web_post where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update tool_web_post set video_url = #{videoUrl}, video_urls = #{videoUrls}, video_count = #{videoCount}, has_video = 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select url from tool_web_post where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update tool_web_post set video_url = #{videoUrl}, video_count = 1, has_video = 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select category as name, count(*) as count from tool_web_post where source = #{source} and category is not null and category != '' group by category order by count(*) desc

select date_format(published_ts, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count from tool_web_post where source = #{source} and published_ts between '1971-01-01' and '2100-01-01' group by published_ts order by published_ts desc
select orientation as o, count(*) as c from tool_web_post where source = #{source} and orientation is not null group by orientation
select count(*) from tool_web_post where source = #{source} and published_ts between '1971-01-01' and '2100-01-01'
select count(*) from tool_web_post where source = #{source}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into tool_web_user_item (owner_key, post_id, kind) values (#{ownerKey}, #{postId}, #{kind})
mapper.delete: delete from tool_web_user_item where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and post_id = #{postId} and kind = #{kind}
mapper.select: select p.id, p.source, p.source_id as sourceId, p.title, p.category, p.tags, p.cover, p.published_at as publishedAt, p.url, p.has_video as hasVideo, case when p.content_text is not null and p.content_text <> '' then 1 else 0 end as hasDetail, i.created_at as markedAt from tool_web_user_item i join tool_web_post p on p.id = i.post_id where i.owner_key = #{ownerKey} and i.kind = #{kind} order by i.created_at desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into tool_web_download (post_id, mode, state, percent, params, kind) values (#{postId}, #{mode}, #{state}, 0, #{params}, #{kind})
mapper.select: select last_insert_id()
mapper.update: update tool_web_download set state = #{state}, percent = #{percent}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, error = #{error}, finished_at = if(#{state} in ('done','error','pending_import'), now(), finished_at) where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select d.id, d.post_id as postId, d.mode, d.state, d.percent, d.size_bytes as sizeBytes, d.params, d.error, d.created_at as createdAt, d.finished_at as finishedAt, p.title, p.source_id as sourceId, p.video_file as videoFile from tool_web_download d left join tool_web_post p on p.id = d.post_id where d.id = #{id}

select d.id, d.post_id as postId, d.mode, d.state, d.percent, d.size_bytes as sizeBytes, d.params, d.error, d.created_at as createdAt, d.finished_at as finishedAt, p.title, p.source_id as sourceId, p.video_file as videoFile, p.cover, (select count(*) from tool_web_download q where q.mode = 'auto' and q.state in ('queued','running') and q.id < d.id) as queueAhead from tool_web_download d left join tool_web_post p on p.id = d.post_id order by d.id desc limit #{limit}
select tag from tool_web_tag_block where owner_key = #{ownerKey} order by created_at desc limit 200
mapper.insert: insert ignore into tool_web_tag_block (owner_key, tag) values (#{ownerKey}, #{tag})
mapper.delete: delete from tool_web_tag_block where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and tag = #{tag}
mapper.select: select count(*) from tool_web_user_item where owner_key = #{ownerKey} and kind = #{kind}
select tags from tool_web_post where source = #{source} and tags is not null and tags != '' order by id desc limit 5000
